title: isachne stenantha
intro: Isachne stenantha, commonly known as Black Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, as well as therapeutic actions like treating fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Black Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, Isachne stenantha has been found to have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential candidate for further research into its therapeutic applications.
